finding: Owner records its one-shot READY send before delivery. Server independently rejects when its reporting-vehicle motion sample is not settled. A transient stale server sample could therefore leave an otherwise held episode without another readiness report. This is a call-path finding, not an observed network failure.
change: At most two READY reports per exact applied hold, at least two seconds apart. Existing ordinary driving callback services retry. Both require original expiry, actual owner/current brain, canonical stationary proposal context, owned zero cap and continuing sampled stillness. Movement after first READY still releases. Publish count/time before RPC; duplicate server reports already coalesce by vehicle.
limits: No ACK or guaranteed delivery. Two rejected reports may leave readiness false until original expiry. No reverse grant, automatic initiation, timer, controller, deadline renewal or native command. Dependency reverse and moving-phase context remain unimplemented.

validation.physical: Unverified; audits paused. Full local regression passed; no physical queue acceptance.
